notes.title: v1.3.2 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello! Just a quick patch to resolve some issues.


 Fixed some item description bugs
 Buffed cross and beam staffs
 Added a new character and achievement
 Made mob pathfinding and movement smoother - the game should feel more responsive
 Fixed a bug with mob discovery
 Fixed a bug in master mode that caused missingno-type monsters to spawn


Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: v1.2.0 - Holiday Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
I just threw together a small update for the holidays. If you play during December or January, you'll get a new main menu design, and unlock a new playable character! (If you're reading this in the future, you can switch your computer's date to have the same effect)

Changes:

 New Holiday main menu
 New character
 2 New Items
 Update to Godot 4.3


As always, let me know if there are any bugs or feature requests!

Have a great holiday season,
- ChillCash

notes.title: Version v1.1.0 Out
notes.notes:
Good news!

I've just released version 1.1.0, which adds the following:

 A new monster on every layer, as well as new items
 Master mode, an even harder difficulty
 Boss monster drops (Only on Master mode)
 Music volume adjustments


I've taken care to make sure every new monster fills in gaps that were missing earlier. Hopefully even more diverse builds will be possible for your runs.

Lastly, I just want to say thank you to everyone who has played Dungeon-Dungeon. A few days ago Dungeon-Dungeon officially became profitable, which means I'll be able to continue making even more games. I appreciate all the support and feedback I have gotten.

I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Well Feedback and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello again!
Just a small update today. Someone reached out to me about a well blocking their path. This made me realize that it might not be obvious that you can move diagonally to get past a well that does that. I've added a bit of text to the well description so future players can know. I'm also working on changing their spawning slightly so that they don't block paths as often.
I've also fixed a few bugs regarding item spawning.

Still working on more content!

notes.title: Prerelease Update
notes.notes:
Dungeon-Dungeon is in the last stages before release. I'm mostly working on quality of life improvements as well as music and bugfixes. I've made some changes to make the process of learning the game a bit easier.

I've pushed a few updates to the live game:

 Added new inspect for mobs
 Fixed some movement bugs
 Adjusted base difficulty settings
 Added more music!


Thank you all for following along and I'm looking forward to release!
